description: Unit tests for known_threats.py. Tests: (1) check_package with known malicious names returns True (2) check_package with clean names returns False (3) check_domain with suspicious TLDs returns True (4) check_domain with clean domains returns False (5) HIGH_RISK_PATTERNS is non-empty list (6) SUSPICIOUS_PERMISSIONS is non-empty list (7) each pattern in HIGH_RISK_PATTERNS is a non-empty string. Uses stdlib unittest. Run: python3 -m pytest tests/test_known_threats.py -v. No daemon.
